premise: Little Fish wonders what lies beyond the rock pool; a wave carries him out into the huge sea, and kind Turtle swims beside him back home.
inspiration: The town-mouse-and-country-mouse fable (Aesop) told as a first adventure: the big world is wonderful, and home is still home.
lesson: It's good to explore, and good to come home.

en-US.title: Little Fish and the Big Sea
en-US.text: {seaweed:enter} In the rock pool, beside the swaying fronds of Seaweed, lived {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Little Fish, yellow with two blue stripes. {seaweed:live sway} Seaweed swayed, slow and gentle. {fish:face happy} The pool was cosy. But Little Fish kept wondering: [curious] what's out there? One day {fish:wash 9s} a wave came sloshing in over the rocks. {sfx:slosh solo} And when it went out again, {fish:go to sea} Little Fish went with it! {fish:face surprised} [in awe] The sea was ENORMOUS. {fish:live look-around} Blue on every side, and no edges at all. {fish:live shiver} He felt very, very small. {fish:face sad} [short pause] Then a kind face came gliding up. {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to fish by swim} It was Turtle. [warmly] Far from home, little one? I'll swim with you. {turtle:hearts} She swam beside him, slow and steady, until he could see the rocks. {fish:go to pool} Then home he swam. {seaweed:live wave} Seaweed waved her fronds. Welcome back! {fish:face happy} {fish:live wiggle} Little Fish wiggled his tail and fluttered his fins. [softly] The sea was wonderful. But the pool was home.

es-ES.title: El pececito y el mar grande
es-ES.text: {seaweed:enter} En la charca, junto a las frondas de Alga, vivía {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Pececito, amarillo con dos rayas azules. {seaweed:live sway} Alga se mecía, despacio y suave. {fish:face happy} La charca era acogedora. Pero Pececito no paraba de preguntarse: [curious] ¿qué habrá ahí fuera? Un día, {fish:wash 9s} una ola entró chapoteando por encima de las rocas. {sfx:slosh solo} Y cuando volvió a salir, {fish:go to sea} ¡Pececito se fue con ella! {fish:face surprised} [in awe] El mar era ENORME. {fish:live look-around} Azul por todas partes, y sin bordes por ningún lado. {fish:live shiver} Se sintió muy, muy pequeño. {fish:face sad} [short pause] Entonces se acercó una cara amable, deslizándose. {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to fish by swim} Era Tortuga. [warmly] ¿Tan lejos de casa, pequeño? Yo nado contigo. {turtle:hearts} Nadó a su lado, despacio y sin parar, hasta que se vieron las rocas. {fish:go to pool} Y entonces Pececito volvió nadando a casa. {seaweed:live wave} Alga movió sus frondas. ¡Bienvenido! {fish:face happy} {fish:live wiggle} Pececito meneó la cola y agitó las aletas. [softly] El mar era maravilloso. Pero la charca era su casa.

ja-JP.title: おさかなくんと 大きな海
ja-JP.text: {seaweed:enter}海藻がゆれる潮だまりに、{fish:enter}{fish:go to pool}おさかなくんがすんでいました。きいろに、青いしまが二本。{seaweed:live sway}海藻は、ゆーらり、ゆーらり。{fish:face happy}いごこちのいい、おうちです。でも、おさかなくんは、いつもおもっていました。[curious]そとには、なにがあるのかな？ある日、{fish:wash 9s}波が、岩をこえて、ざぶーん！{sfx:slosh solo}その波がひいていくと…{fish:go to sea}おさかなくんも、いっしょにながされてしまいました！{fish:face surprised}[in awe]海は、とーっても大きい！{fish:live look-around}どっちを見ても、青、青、青。はしっこなんて、ありません。{fish:live shiver}じぶんが、ちっちゃく、ちっちゃく、かんじます。{fish:face sad}[short pause]そのとき、やさしい顔が、すうっとちかづいてきました。{turtle:enter by swim}{turtle:go to fish by swim}ウミガメさんです。[warmly]「おうちからとおいのね、ぼうや。いっしょに、およぎましょう」 {turtle:hearts}となりを、ゆっくり、ゆっくり、およいでくれます。岩が見えてくるまで。{fish:go to pool}おさかなくんは、潮だまりへ、すいすい。{seaweed:live wave}海藻が、ゆらゆら手をふります。「おかえり！」 {fish:face happy}{fish:live wiggle}おさかなくんは、しっぽをぴちぴち、ひれをひらひら。[softly]海は、すばらしかった。でも、おうちは、やっぱり潮だまり。

de-DE.title: Das Fischchen und das große Meer
de-DE.text: {seaweed:enter} Im Tümpel, gleich neben dem wiegenden Seetang, wohnte {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} das Fischchen, gelb mit zwei blauen Streifen. {seaweed:live sway} Der Seetang wiegte sich, langsam und sanft. {fish:face happy} Im Tümpel war es gemütlich. Aber das Fischchen fragte sich immer wieder: [curious] Was gibt es wohl da draußen? Eines Tages {fish:wash 9s} schwappte eine Welle über die Felsen herein. {sfx:slosh solo} Und als sie wieder hinauslief, {fish:go to sea} schwamm das Fischchen mit hinaus! {fish:face surprised} [in awe] Das Meer war RIESIG. {fish:live look-around} Blau, wohin es auch schaute, und nirgendwo ein Rand. {fish:live shiver} Es fühlte sich ganz, ganz klein. {fish:face sad} [short pause] Da kam ein freundliches Gesicht herangeglitten. {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to fish by swim} Es war die Meeresschildkröte. [warmly] „So weit weg von zu Hause, Kleines? Ich schwimme mit dir.“ {turtle:hearts} Sie schwamm neben ihm her, langsam und stetig, bis es die Felsen sehen konnte. {fish:go to pool} Dann schwamm es heim. {seaweed:live wave} Der Seetang winkte mit seinen Blättern. „Willkommen zurück!“ {fish:face happy} {fish:live wiggle} Das Fischchen wackelte mit dem Schwanz und zappelte mit den Flossen. [softly] Das Meer war wunderbar. Aber der Tümpel war sein Zuhause.

fr-FR.title: Petit Poisson et la grande mer
fr-FR.text: {seaweed:enter} Dans la mare, à côté des longs rubans d’Algue, vivait {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Petit Poisson, jaune avec deux rayures bleues. {seaweed:live sway} Algue se balançait, lentement, doucement. {fish:face happy} On était bien, dans la mare. Mais Petit Poisson se demandait toujours : [curious] qu’est-ce qu’il y a, là-bas, plus loin ? Un jour, {fish:wash 9s} une vague est entrée par-dessus les rochers, floc, floc. {sfx:slosh solo} Et quand elle est repartie, {fish:go to sea} Petit Poisson est parti avec elle ! {fish:face surprised} [in awe] La mer était IMMENSE. {fish:live look-around} Du bleu partout, partout, à perte de vue. {fish:live shiver} Il s’est senti tout petit, tout, tout petit. {fish:face sad} [short pause] Puis un gentil visage s’est approché en glissant. {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to fish by swim} C’était Tortue de mer. [warmly] « Tu es loin de chez toi, mon petit ? Je vais nager avec toi. » {turtle:hearts} Elle a nagé à côté de lui, lentement mais sûrement, jusqu’à ce qu’il aperçoive les rochers. {fish:go to pool} Alors il est rentré chez lui à la nage. {seaweed:live wave} Algue a agité ses rubans. « Bon retour ! » {fish:face happy} {fish:live wiggle} Petit Poisson a remué la queue et frétillé des nageoires. [softly] La mer, c’était merveilleux. Mais sa maison, c’était la mare.

it-IT.title: Pesciolino e il grande mare
it-IT.text: {seaweed:enter} Nella pozza, accanto alle foglie ondeggianti di Alga, viveva {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Pesciolino, giallo con due strisce blu. {seaweed:live sway} Alga ondeggiava, piano e leggera. {fish:face happy} La pozza era accogliente. Ma Pesciolino continuava a chiedersi: [curious] che cosa c'è là fuori? Un giorno {fish:wash 9s} un'onda è arrivata sciabordando sopra gli scogli. {sfx:slosh solo} E quando è tornata indietro, {fish:go to sea} Pesciolino è andato via con lei! {fish:face surprised} [in awe] Il mare era ENORME. {fish:live look-around} Blu dappertutto, e nessuna sponda da nessuna parte. {fish:live shiver} Si sentiva piccolo piccolo. {fish:face sad} [short pause] Poi è arrivato, scivolando, un musetto gentile. {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to fish by swim} Era Tartaruga marina. [warmly] «Sei lontano da casa, piccolino? Nuoto io con te.» {turtle:hearts} Gli è rimasta accanto, piano e senza fretta, finché lui ha visto gli scogli. {fish:go to pool} Allora è tornato a casa, nuotando. {seaweed:live wave} Alga ha agitato le sue foglie. «Bentornato!» {fish:face happy} {fish:live wiggle} Pesciolino ha dimenato la coda e ha sventolato le pinne. [softly] Il mare era meraviglioso. Ma la pozza era casa sua.

zh-TW.title: 小魚和大海
zh-TW.text: {seaweed:enter}在潮池裡，海草的長葉子輕輕搖擺，旁邊住著{fish:enter}{fish:go to pool}小魚，黃黃的身體，有兩條藍色的條紋。{seaweed:live sway}海草慢慢地、輕輕地搖呀搖。{fish:face happy}潮池裡暖暖的，好舒服。可是小魚一直在想：[curious]外面有什麼呢？有一天，{fish:wash 9s}一道浪嘩啦啦地越過岩石，打進潮池。{sfx:slosh solo}浪退回去的時候，{fish:go to sea}小魚也跟著被帶走了！{fish:face surprised}[in awe]大海好——大——喔！{fish:live look-around}前後左右都是藍藍的，怎麼看都看不到邊。{fish:live shiver}小魚覺得自己好小、好小。{fish:face sad}[short pause]這時候，一張溫柔的臉，慢慢地滑了過來。{turtle:enter by swim}{turtle:go to fish by swim}是海龜。[warmly]「小傢伙，離家這麼遠呀？我陪你游一段吧。」 {turtle:hearts}牠游在小魚旁邊，慢慢的，穩穩的，一直游到看得見大石頭的地方。{fish:go to pool}小魚就自己游回家了。{seaweed:live wave}海草搖搖她的長葉子：「歡迎回來！」 {fish:face happy}{fish:live wiggle}小魚搖搖尾巴，擺擺鰭。[softly]大海好棒好棒。可是，潮池才是家。

zh-HK.title: 小魚和大海
zh-HK.text: 在石池裏，{seaweed:enter}海草輕輕擺動着長長的葉子，在她旁邊，住着{fish:enter}{fish:go to pool}小魚。小魚黃色的身上，有兩條藍色的間紋。{seaweed:live sway}海草慢慢地、輕輕地搖擺。{fish:face happy}石池很舒服。可是小魚常常在想：[curious]外面有甚麼呢？有一天，{fish:wash 9s}一個浪越過岩石，嘩啦嘩啦地湧了進來。{sfx:slosh solo}浪退出去的時候，{fish:go to sea}小魚也跟着出去了！{fish:face surprised}[in awe]大海好大好大呀！{fish:live look-around}四面八方都是藍色，怎樣也看不到邊。{fish:live shiver}牠覺得自己好小好小。{fish:face sad}[short pause]這時，一張和善的臉，慢慢地游了過來。{turtle:enter by swim}{turtle:go to fish by swim}原來是海龜。[warmly]「細路，你係咪離屋企好遠呀？我陪你游啦。」 {turtle:hearts}牠在小魚身邊游着，慢慢地，穩穩地，一直游到看得見岩石的地方。{fish:go to pool}然後，小魚自己游回家了。{seaweed:live wave}海草揮揮她的葉子：「歡迎返嚟！」 {fish:face happy}{fish:live wiggle}小魚擺擺尾巴，拍拍魚鰭。[softly]大海真美妙。可是石池，才是牠的家。
